title: Identification of novel therapeutic inhibitors against E6 and E7 oncogenes of HPV-16 associated with cervical cancer.
authors: Younas, Saima; Malik, Zaryab Ikram; Khan, Muhammad Umer; Manzoor, Sadia; Rehman, Hafiz Muzzammel; Hammad, Hafiz Muhammad; Akter, Shahina
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟寻找HPV-16 E6/E7癌蛋白的小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为病毒癌蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法上无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Human Papilloma Virus type 16 (HPV-16) is highly oncogenic with the E6 and E7 oncogenes playing crucial roles in the pathogenesis of HPV-related cervical carcinogenesis. Targeting these oncoproteins with specific inhibitors offers a promising approach for therapeutic intervention. This study aimed to identify potential inhibitors of the HPV-16 E6 and E7 oncoproteins through an in silico approach, providing a foundation for the development of targeted therapies against HPV associated malignancies. We performed virtual screening on a library of 1000 compounds to identify promising candidates. Subsequent molecular docking studies were conducted to assess the binding affinities of the promising candidates. The top-scoring compounds for oncoproteins were then subjected to molecular dynamics simulations to evaluate their stability and interaction profiles. The virtual screening identified 14 promising candidates followed by docking studies. Among these Galangin was identified as a promising inhibitor for the E6 oncogene, while Neoechinulin showed potential as an inhibitor of the E7 oncogene. Our findings suggest Galangin and Neoechinulin with high potential as therapeutic inhibitors of HPV-16 E6 and E7 oncogenes respectively. These inhibitors could contribute significantly to the development of targeted therapies against HPV associated malignancies. However, further in vitro and in vivo investigations are required to use these phytochemicals as antiviral agents against HPV-16.
abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒16型（HPV-16）具有高度致癌性，其中E6和E7癌基因在HPV相关宫颈癌发生的发病机制中发挥关键作用。通过特异性抑制剂靶向这些癌蛋白为治疗干预提供了一种有前景的方法。本研究旨在通过计算机模拟方法识别HPV-16 E6和E7癌蛋白的潜在抑制剂，为开发针对HPV相关恶性肿瘤的靶向治疗奠定基础。我们对包含1000种化合物的文库进行了虚拟筛选，以识别有前景的候选分子。随后进行了分子对接研究，以评估这些候选分子的结合亲和力。针对癌蛋白得分最高的化合物随后进行了分子动力学模拟，以评估其稳定性和相互作用特征。虚拟筛选识别出14个有前景的候选分子，随后进行了对接研究。其中，高良姜素（Galangin）被确定为E6癌基因的有前景抑制剂，而新echinulin（Neoechinulin）则显示出作为E7癌基因抑制剂的潜力。我们的研究结果表明，高良姜素和新echinulin分别具有作为HPV-16 E6和E7癌基因治疗抑制剂的高潜力。这些抑制剂可能对开发针对HPV相关恶性肿瘤的靶向治疗做出重要贡献。然而，仍需进一步的体外和体内研究，以将这些植物化学物质用作抗HPV-16的抗病毒药物。
